You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From 4a7d9a840ef8ba1c4fb5e9261b5334e9243434a7 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: David von Oheimb <David.von.Oheimb@siemens.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Aug 2018 14:55:24 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] fix minor build issue introduced in commit 884f23b8b720

---
 apps/cmp.c | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/apps/cmp.c b/apps/cmp.c
index 821c1e3c06..ed826d211a 100644
--- a/apps/cmp.c
+++ b/apps/cmp.c
@@ -1958,7 +1958,7 @@ static int read_write_req_resp(OSSL_CMP_CTX *ctx, const OSSL_CMP_MSG *req,
     return ret;
 }
 
-const char *tls_error_hint(unsigned long err)
+static const char *tls_error_hint(unsigned long err)
 {
     switch(ERR_GET_REASON(err)) {
 /*  case 0x1408F10B: */ /* xSL_F_SSL3_GET_RECORD */
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The root cause of the bug is that the function `tls_error_hint` was mistakenly declared with default linkage instead of static linkage in the previous commit (commit 884f23b8b720). This could lead to an inconsistency in the symbol visibility and potential linkage issues in other translation units that could inadvertently access this function. By changing the function declaration to `static`, the patch restricts its visibility to the current file, preventing any external linkage issues. This minor build issue could cause linker errors or warnings when building the application if the function was not intended to be accessible from other files.

You are a programming expert.
    You will be given the root cause of a bug and  the corresponding patch.
    You need to extract the code statements that lead to the bug from  the patch, based on the root cause.

    
    Provide a response strictly in the following format:
    Code statements:
    <text1>
    <text2>
    <text3>
    <text4>
    ...
    <textN>

Root cause:
The root cause of the bug is that the function `tls_error_hint` was mistakenly declared with default linkage instead of static linkage in the previous commit (commit 884f23b8b720). This could lead to an inconsistency in the symbol visibility and potential linkage issues in other translation units that could inadvertently access this function. By changing the function declaration to `static`, the patch restricts its visibility to the current file, preventing any external linkage issues. This minor build issue could cause linker errors or warnings when building the application if the function was not intended to be accessible from other files.
